Overview

This feature service provides sidewalk information for the Westbank First Nation (WFN) area and supports local inventory and mapping needs for pedestrian infrastructure.

Feature Layer

  • Sidewalks: A line feature layer representing sidewalk segments. It includes basic reference information and notes, along with geometry length information used to support spatial management and analysis.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers the Westbank First Nation (WFN).

Use Cases

  • Viewing and maintaining sidewalk locations
  • Supporting pedestrian network and accessibility planning
  • Documenting local infrastructure notes and reference details

License and Attribution
